description: The signature v4 behavior. The Read must LEAD with the load story (the state's 'Load trend' line, with a percentage and window), name real sessions specifically (the 9×1K at 5K pace, not 'your intervals'), tie at least one claim to a change over a stated window, quote fitness as a RANGE with confidence (never a single time), and never quote ACWR or invent seconds-precision finish times. Redesign §3.1/§3.6. The recorded_response is an authored target exemplar — re-record against the live model via _evals/record.ts before trusting it as a regression baseline.
